title: docc
body: docc is a compiler and linter for documentation written as JSON. It checks structure, links, content and style, and builds Markdown for people to read.
Start with [[document-model]] to see what a document looks like, then [[agent-workflow]] for the loop an agent follows.
The rest of the description: [[goals]], [[rules]], [[commands]], [[config]], [[rendering]], [[architecture]], [[performance]] and [[decisions]].
